---
title: "03_season_analysis"
output: html_document
---

Purpose: process the per-species seasonal stage x Bd models (`02_season_modeling.qmd`) into
stage curves, subadult - adult contrast curves, per-species summaries, a consistency check
against the unified model (m11g) and a first-pass typology, and export basic results.

Scales used throughout:

- **prevalence part**: the model's hurdle (hu) is the probability of a zero (Bd not
  detected). Curves are shown as prevalence = 1 - hu. Contrasts are on the **logit prevalence**
  scale (= -logit(hu)), so a positive contrast means subadults are *more often infected*.
- **load part**: mu = mean log Bd load density among positive swabs. Contrasts are differences in
  mu (log scale), so a positive contrast means subadults carry *higher loads when infected*.
- All curves exclude random effects (`re_formula = NA`): they describe a typical population and
  year, not any one site.

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, brms, patchwork, arrow)

models_dir = here("size_bd_season", "models")
figures_dir = here("size_bd_season", "figures")
intermediates_dir = here("size_bd_season", "intermediates")
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(intermediates_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

# load models
```{r}
# same species and file names as 02_season_modeling.qmd / the cluster script
season_species = c("anaxyrus_canorus",
                   "rana_cascadae",
                   "rana_catesbeiana",
                   "rana_clamitans",
                   "rana_muscosa",
                   "rana_sierrae")

model_list = purrr::map(set_names(season_species), function(spp) {
  readRDS(file.path(models_dir, paste0("size_bd_season_model_zln_s1_", spp, ".rds")))
})

```

# sampling windows
```{r}
# curves are only meaningful where data exist. as in the screen (01_season_screen.Rmd), a week
# counts as sampled for a stage with >= min_n_co swabs (prevalence) or >= min_pos_co positive
# swabs (load). the contrast is only reported in weeks where BOTH stages are sampled
# ("co-sampled"); elsewhere it is an extrapolation of one stage's curve.
min_n_co = 5
min_pos_co = 3

# the model data hold season_m (months from july 1), not the date; recover day of year
week_of = function(doy) pmin(ceiling(doy / 7), 52)

stage_weeks = imap_dfr(model_list, function(fit, spp) {
  fit$data %>%
    mutate(doy = round(season_m * 30.44 + 182),
           week = week_of(doy)) %>%
    group_by(life_stage_simple, week) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              n_pos = sum(bd_load_co100_density > 0),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(taxon_capture = spp,
           sampled_prevalence = n >= min_n_co,
           sampled_load = n_pos >= min_pos_co)
})

co_weeks = stage_weeks %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, week) %>%
  summarise(co_prevalence = sum(sampled_prevalence) == 2,
            co_load = sum(sampled_load) == 2,
            .groups = "drop")

co_weeks %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(co_weeks_prevalence = sum(co_prevalence),
            co_weeks_load = sum(co_load),
            first_co_week = min(week[co_prevalence]),
            last_co_week = max(week[co_prevalence]))

```

# draws
```{r}
# for each species: linear predictor draws for both parts and both stages on a daily grid
# spanning the species' sampled days. posterior_linpred(transform = FALSE) returns the link
# scale (logit for hu, log for mu); a draws x grid-rows matrix. working with matrices (rather
# than long tibbles of draws) keeps r. sierrae (8000 draws) manageable.
species_draws = function(fit) {
  doy_obs = round(fit$data$season_m * 30.44 + 182)

  grid = expand_grid(life_stage_simple = factor(c("adult", "subadult"), levels = c("adult", "subadult")),
                     doy = seq(min(doy_obs), max(doy_obs))) %>%
    mutate(season_m = (doy - 182) / 30.44)

  hu = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = grid, dpar = "hu", re_formula = NA)
  mu = posterior_linpred(fit, newdata = grid, dpar = "mu", re_formula = NA)

  ad = grid$life_stage_simple == "adult"
  sa = grid$life_stage_simple == "subadult"

  list(doy = grid$doy[ad],              # same day sequence for both stages
       doy_obs = doy_obs,
       stage_obs = fit$data$life_stage_simple,
       # logit prevalence = -logit(hu)
       logit_prev = list(adult = -hu[, ad], subadult = -hu[, sa]),
       mu = list(adult = mu[, ad], subadult = mu[, sa]))
}

draws_list = purrr::map(model_list, species_draws)

```

# summarise curves
```{r}
# column-wise median and 50% / 95% intervals of a draws x days matrix
summ_cols = function(m) {
  q = apply(m, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.975))
  tibble(median = q[3, ], lower_95 = q[1, ], lower_50 = q[2, ],
         upper_50 = q[4, ], upper_95 = q[5, ])
}

# stage curves: prevalence on the probability scale, load on the log scale
stage_curves = imap_dfr(draws_list, function(dl, spp) {
  bind_rows(
    map_dfr(c("adult", "subadult"), ~ tibble(life_stage_simple = .x, doy = dl$doy,
                                              summ_cols(plogis(dl$logit_prev[[.x]])))) %>%
      mutate(metric = "prevalence"),
    map_dfr(c("adult", "subadult"), ~ tibble(life_stage_simple = .x, doy = dl$doy,
                                              summ_cols(dl$mu[[.x]]))) %>%
      mutate(metric = "load")
  ) %>%
    mutate(taxon_capture = spp)
}) %>%
  mutate(week = week_of(doy)) %>%
  left_join(stage_weeks %>% select(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, week,
                                   sampled_prevalence, sampled_load),
            by = c("taxon_capture", "life_stage_simple", "week")) %>%
  mutate(sampled = if_else(metric == "prevalence", sampled_prevalence, sampled_load),
         sampled = replace_na(sampled, FALSE)) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, life_stage_simple, doy, week, sampled, everything(),
         -sampled_prevalence, -sampled_load)

# contrast curves: subadult - adult per draw (logit prevalence, log load)
contrast_curves = imap_dfr(draws_list, function(dl, spp) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(metric = "prevalence", doy = dl$doy,
           summ_cols(dl$logit_prev$subadult - dl$logit_prev$adult),
           p_gt_0 = colMeans(dl$logit_prev$subadult - dl$logit_prev$adult > 0)),
    tibble(metric = "load", doy = dl$doy,
           summ_cols(dl$mu$subadult - dl$mu$adult),
           p_gt_0 = colMeans(dl$mu$subadult - dl$mu$adult > 0))
  ) %>%
    mutate(taxon_capture = spp)
}) %>%
  mutate(week = week_of(doy)) %>%
  left_join(co_weeks, by = c("taxon_capture", "week")) %>%
  mutate(co_sampled = if_else(metric == "prevalence", co_prevalence, co_load),
         co_sampled = replace_na(co_sampled, FALSE)) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, doy, week, co_sampled, everything(), -co_prevalence, -co_load)

```

# contrast summaries
```{r}
# per species and part, from the per-draw contrast over co-sampled days:
#   early / late   mean contrast over the first / last third of co-sampled days. thirds rather
#                  than the window's end points: spline estimates at the edges of the data are
#                  the least certain, and a single day is noisy
#   late_minus_early  how much the stage gap changes through the season (> 0: subadults gain
#                  relative to adults)
#   window_mean    mean contrast over all co-sampled days (each day weighted equally)
# p_* values are posterior probabilities (share of draws).
contrast_summary_draws = function(dl, spp, metric) {
  m = if (metric == "prevalence") dl$logit_prev else dl$mu
  contrast = m$subadult - m$adult

  co = co_weeks %>% filter(taxon_capture == spp)
  co_week_set = co$week[co[[paste0("co_", metric)]]]
  idx = which(week_of(dl$doy) %in% co_week_set)
  if (length(idx) < 3) return(NULL)

  thirds = cut(seq_along(idx), 3, labels = FALSE)
  early = rowMeans(contrast[, idx[thirds == 1], drop = FALSE])
  late = rowMeans(contrast[, idx[thirds == 3], drop = FALSE])

  tibble(taxon_capture = spp, metric = metric, .draw = seq_along(early),
         early = early, late = late,
         late_minus_early = late - early,
         window_mean = rowMeans(contrast[, idx, drop = FALSE]),
         first_co_doy = min(dl$doy[idx]),
         last_co_doy = max(dl$doy[idx]))
}

summary_draws = imap_dfr(draws_list, function(dl, spp) {
  bind_rows(contrast_summary_draws(dl, spp, "prevalence"),
            contrast_summary_draws(dl, spp, "load"))
})

q_str = function(x) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median(x), quantile(x, 0.025), quantile(x, 0.975))

contrast_summary = summary_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, metric, first_co_doy, last_co_doy) %>%
  summarise(across(c(early, late, late_minus_early, window_mean),
                   list(median = median,
                        lower_95 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.025),
                        upper_95 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.975))),
            p_early_gt_0 = mean(early > 0),
            p_late_gt_0 = mean(late > 0),
            p_late_gt_early = mean(late > early),
            # is the gap smaller (in absolute size) late than early?
            p_abs_shrinks = mean(abs(late) < abs(early)),
            .groups = "drop")

# readable version
summary_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, metric) %>%
  summarise(early = q_str(early),
            late = q_str(late),
            late_minus_early = q_str(late_minus_early),
            p_late_gt_early = round(mean(late > early), 3),
            window_mean = q_str(window_mean),
            .groups = "drop")

```

# typology (first pass)
```{r}
# a rule-based classification of how the stage gap changes through the season, per species and
# part. thresholds are deliberately simple and written out so they can be revised:
#   reversing   the contrast is credibly one sign early and credibly the other sign late
#               (p > 0.9 for each end)
#   constant    the change late - early is not credible (p_late_gt_early between 0.1 and 0.9):
#               the season does not detectably alter the gap
#   converging  the gap credibly changes and shrinks in absolute size (p_abs_shrinks > 0.9)
#   diverging   the gap credibly changes and grows in absolute size (p_abs_shrinks < 0.1)
#   shifting    the gap credibly changes, but whether it shrinks or grows is unclear (e.g. it
#               starts near 0)
# 0.9 rather than 0.95: this is a descriptive typology over 6 species, not a test.
typology_p = 0.9

typology = contrast_summary %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(
    (p_early_gt_0 > typology_p & p_late_gt_0 < 1 - typology_p) |
      (p_early_gt_0 < 1 - typology_p & p_late_gt_0 > typology_p) ~ "reversing",
    p_late_gt_early > 1 - typology_p & p_late_gt_early < typology_p ~ "constant",
    p_abs_shrinks > typology_p ~ "converging",
    p_abs_shrinks < 1 - typology_p ~ "diverging",
    .default = "shifting")) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, type, early_median, late_median,
         p_late_gt_early, p_abs_shrinks)

typology

typology %>%
  select(taxon_capture, metric, type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = type)

```

# consistency with the unified model (m11g)
```{r}
# does the seasonal model agree with m11g's overall subadult - adult contrast? m11g has no
# season term and evaluates the contrast at each species' median subadult weather, so the
# closest seasonal equivalent is the contrast averaged over the days subadults were actually
# swabbed (weighting each day by its number of subadult swabs). the two will not match exactly:
#   - m11g has weather terms and a different random-effect / prior structure
#   - m11g's contrast is at one weather point, this one averages over the season
# large disagreements (intervals not overlapping) would be worth understanding before
# interpreting the seasonal curves.
subadult_weighted = imap_dfr(draws_list, function(dl, spp) {
  sa_doy = dl$doy_obs[dl$stage_obs == "subadult"]
  w = tabulate(match(sa_doy, dl$doy), nbins = length(dl$doy))
  w = w / sum(w)
  tibble(taxon_capture = spp,
         .draw = seq_len(nrow(dl$mu$adult)),
         prevalence = as.vector((dl$logit_prev$subadult - dl$logit_prev$adult) %*% w),
         load = as.vector((dl$mu$subadult - dl$mu$adult) %*% w))
}) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, load), names_to = "metric", values_to = "contrast") %>%
  mutate(model = "seasonal (subadult-date weighted)")

# m11g species x stage draws (link scale), exported by 03_size_bd_unified_analysis.qmd
m11g_draws = read_parquet(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates",
                               "unified_03_b_spp_lss_draws.parquet")) %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% season_species) %>%
  select(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, .draw, hu, mu) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = life_stage_simple, values_from = c(hu, mu)) %>%
  transmute(taxon_capture, .draw,
            # logit prevalence = -logit(hu)
            prevalence = -(hu_subadult - hu_adult),
            load = mu_subadult - mu_adult) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(prevalence, load), names_to = "metric", values_to = "contrast") %>%
  mutate(model = "unified m11g")

consistency = bind_rows(subadult_weighted, m11g_draws) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, metric, model) %>%
  summarise(median = median(contrast),
            lower_95 = quantile(contrast, 0.025),
            upper_95 = quantile(contrast, 0.975),
            lower_50 = quantile(contrast, 0.25),
            upper_50 = quantile(contrast, 0.75),
            .groups = "drop")

consistency

p_consistency = consistency %>%
  mutate(species = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)),
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("prevalence", "load"),
                         labels = c("logit prevalence contrast", "log load contrast"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = median, y = species, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower_95, xmax = upper_95), linewidth = 0.5,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower_50, xmax = upper_50), linewidth = 1.5,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1B9E77", "#7570B3")) +
  labs(x = "subadult - adult (median, 50% / 95% interval)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_consistency_m11g.png"), p_consistency, width = 9, height = 4.5)

p_consistency

```

# visualize
```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 12

stage_colors = c(adult = "#7570B3", subadult = "#D95F02")

doy_to_date = function(doy) as.Date(doy - 1, origin = "2001-01-01")   # dummy year, for month labels

# stage curves: solid where the stage was sampled, faint where the curve is extrapolated between
# or beyond sampled weeks
plot_stage_curves = function(curves, metric_name, y_lab) {
  d = curves %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(date = doy_to_date(doy),
           species = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)),
           # NA breaks the line / ribbon outside sampled weeks
           across(c(median, lower_50, upper_50, lower_95, upper_95),
                  ~ if_else(sampled, .x, NA_real_), .names = "{.col}_s"))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = date, group = life_stage_simple)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median, color = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95_s, ymax = upper_95_s, fill = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_50_s, ymax = upper_50_s, fill = life_stage_simple), alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median_s, color = life_stage_simple), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b") +
    scale_color_manual(values = stage_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = stage_colors) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab, color = "stage", fill = "stage",
         subtitle = "typical population and year (random effects excluded); faint line = outside sampled weeks") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
}

# contrast curves over co-sampled weeks only
plot_contrast_curves = function(curves, metric_name, y_lab, color) {
  d = curves %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    mutate(date = doy_to_date(doy),
           species = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)),
           across(c(median, lower_50, upper_50, lower_95, upper_95),
                  ~ if_else(co_sampled, .x, NA_real_)))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = date)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), fill = color, alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_50, ymax = upper_50), fill = color, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab,
         subtitle = "co-sampled weeks only; > 0 = subadults higher") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "italic"))
}

p_stage_prev = plot_stage_curves(stage_curves, "prevalence", "Bd prevalence")
p_stage_load = plot_stage_curves(stage_curves, "load", "log Bd load (positives)")
p_contrast_prev = plot_contrast_curves(contrast_curves, "prevalence",
                                       "subadult - adult (logit prevalence)", "#8DA0CB")
p_contrast_load = plot_contrast_curves(contrast_curves, "load",
                                       "subadult - adult (log load)", "#FC8D62")

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_stage_curves_prevalence.png"), p_stage_prev, width = 12, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_stage_curves_load.png"), p_stage_load, width = 12, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_contrast_curves_prevalence.png"), p_contrast_prev, width = 12, height = 7)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "03_contrast_curves_load.png"), p_contrast_load, width = 12, height = 7)

p_stage_prev
p_stage_load
p_contrast_prev
p_contrast_load

```

# export
```{r}
# local intermediates
write_csv(stage_curves, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_season_stage_curves.csv"))
write_csv(contrast_curves, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_season_contrast_curves.csv"))
write_csv(contrast_summary, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_season_contrast_summary.csv"))
write_csv(typology, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_season_typology.csv"))
write_csv(consistency, file.path(intermediates_dir, "03_season_consistency_m11g.csv"))

# manuscript essential data. stage curves are absolute levels (comparable within a species
# only: labs differ); center within species when plotting in build_intermediates.Rmd, as for the
# seasonal tile plots
repo_dir = gsub("size_bd_load_analysis", "", here())
manuscript_data_dir = paste0(repo_dir, "size-bd-dynamics-manuscript/resources/01_essential_data/")

write_parquet(stage_curves, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_03_a_stage_curves.parquet"))
write_csv(contrast_summary %>% left_join(typology %>% select(taxon_capture, metric, type),
                                         by = c("taxon_capture", "metric")),
          paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_03_b_contrast_summary.csv"))
write_parquet(contrast_curves, paste0(manuscript_data_dir, "season_03_c_contrast_curves.parquet"))

```
